name: torstack
description: Lint/format tooling untuk file JS torstack (sisanya shell).

scripts.check:all: bash tools/biome check . && bash tools/biome check --stdin-file-path=bin/tor-dashboard.ts < bin/tor-dashboard > /dev/null
scripts.fmt:dashboard: bash tools/biome format --stdin-file-path=bin/tor-dashboard.ts --write < bin/tor-dashboard > bin/tor-dashboard.new && mv bin/tor-dashboard.new bin/tor-dashboard
